scope: Independent read-only static code/spec review and existing unit-evidence inspection only; no compile, solver, performance run, Git write, or implementation changes.
findings: H=q is explicitly a biased confirmed-refault heat proxy, not complete access frequency.
Age removes one unit per 64 visible hit+miss increments, retains positive-heat remainder, and anchors a new reward at original miss when prior heat is zero.
Pending LOAD reward is miss-dated and aged at confirmation; first subsequent still-disk observation discards pending reward. Successful reward clock deduplicates repeated same-clock cycles.
Confirmed own legal PROBE spills preserve H and establish ghost only on next observed disk state. BF fallback actions pass through intent recording.
Size identity, clock rollback/overflow, memory limit, shape and reverse lifecycle invalidate appropriate adaptation; unsupported >512 shape uses frozen BF.

Single-victim score is frozen c0 plus double(H)*double(b)*(1/w+1/r). All sufficient positive resident singles except active target participate; deterministic frozen ties and unchanged BF fallback remain.
Cap floor(M/b), guarded x.h<cap increment, and double conversion before multiplication avoid H+1 and H*b overflow on valid states. Checked clock sum falls back safely.
All state maintenance occurs inside official callbacks; periodic work is O(operator count + pending), with full 512 reset only on invalidation.
Diagnostic getters are compile-gated const reads. Effective diagnostic H must use cached size equality and offline aging from debugAnchor without touching policy.

warnings: Assumes official valid physical state, contiguous operator/partition identities, nonnegative valid sizes and finite positive bandwidths, consistent with frozen predecessor contract.
Unit tests are not performance evidence, hardware measurements, or proof of complete action legality across arbitrary malformed states. Formal nine-cell execution remains coordinator work.
Cached H may be stale until touched; diagnostic output must not treat debugHeat alone as effective current H. Invisible size/lifecycle changes between official callbacks cannot be observed.
